description: This file provides utility functions and types for managing SSH sandbox sessions, including creation, disposal, command execution, file uploads, and SSH configuration parsing within a sandboxed environment. It includes interactions with child processes, file system operations, and SSH session management specifically tailored for a sandbox environment in a larger project.

methods.name: function normalizeInlineSshMaterial(contents: string, filename: string): string { normalizeInlineSshMaterial
methods.description: Normalizes SSH key material by removing BOM, normalizing newlines, and handling escaped newlines depending on file name.

methods.name: function buildSshFailureMessage(stderr: string, exitCode?: number): string { buildSshFailureMessage
methods.description: Generates a user-friendly error message when SSH command fails, especially related to key issues.

methods.name: export function shellEscape(value: string): string { shellEscape
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe inclusion in a shell command.

methods.name: buildRemoteCommand
methods.description: Constructs a shell command string from argument array with proper escaping.

methods.name: buildExecRemoteCommand
methods.description: Builds a shell command string to execute with optional working directory and environment variables.

methods.name: buildSshSandboxArgv
methods.description: Constructs the argument vector for invoking SSH with the sandbox session parameters.

methods.name: createSshSandboxSessionFromConfigText
methods.description: Creates an SSH sandbox session from provided config text, generating config files and returning session info.

methods.name: createSshSandboxSessionFromSettings
methods.description: Creates an SSH sandbox session from settings, including handling key materials and config file creation.

methods.name: disposeSshSandboxSession
methods.description: Removes temporary files and configuration for a given SSH sandbox session.

methods.name: runSshSandboxCommand
methods.description: Executes an SSH command in sandbox, capturing output and handling errors.

methods.name: uploadDirectoryToSshTarget
methods.description: Uploads a directory to the SSH target within the sandbox, ensuring symlinks are safe.

methods.name: assertSafeUploadSymlinks
methods.description: Checks for symlinks escaping the workspace during upload and prevents unsafe symlinks.
